name: cel-go-recoverable-parse-sessions
instr:
cel-go cannot parse malformed input into an inspectable partial AST with a durable, source-ordered recovery account and explicit completion state. Implement this across both parser engines, macro expansion, environment configuration, AST conversion, and checking without changing ordinary parsing.

Every recovery action produced by the ANTLR-backed or Pratt-backed parser or by macro expansion is reported in source encounter order as inserted, skipped, synchronized, macro-failed, or limit-exhausted, using actual parser tokens and recovery decisions without exposing parser internals; placeholder and recovered macro substitutions retain their expression identity, original call location, and macro-call tracking semantics. Preserve existing diagnostics, partial-tree behavior, source locations, and macro-call semantics. Order events by source encounter. Each ExprID must resolve within the returned AST or explicitly denote no expression association.

Keep recovery reports immutable across AST copying, expression replacement, conversion, and mutation of caller-owned slices. Retain associations only while representable. RecoveryReporting filters observations only; it must not affect recovery, errors, AST shape, limits, parser selection, macros, or parent environments. Existing Parser.Parse and package Parse behavior remains unchanged without reporting.

Conversion preserves completion and surviving associations. ASTs without recovery metadata receive an empty RecoveryComplete report. C
